title: Let It All Hang Out
writer: Horst Hächler, Dick Randall, Alfredo Medori
actors: Willi Colombini, Marcella Michelangeli, Edwige Fenech
plot: Edwige Fenech plays the girlfriend of beatnik-hippy artist Archie (Willi Colombini). Throughout the film Edwige is either having her body painted during a hippy party, posing naked for Archie or seducing other men. All is not fun ...
